hero.title: Want us in your city? Let's talk.
hero.subtitle: PARX Open is growing beyond its first five legs. Bring a full rallycross weekend to your city or province.

benefits.title: A full race weekend
benefits.text: Friday Parc Exposé and welcome party, two days of timed stages, and a Sunday awarding ceremony.

benefits.title: Visitors and local business
benefits.text: Teams, crews and spectators travel in, and stay, eat and shop locally.

benefits.title: Your city on our channels
benefits.text: Every leg is filmed, photographed and shared across our video, photo and social channels.

benefits.title: Local partners
benefits.text: Hotels, caterers, venues and local businesses can join as Local Partners.

lookingFor: Open ground suitable for a rallycross course (dirt or mixed surface)
Support from the LGU or a local organiser
Space for spectators, parking and food vendors
